title: Proclaiming Christ Crucified, The Revelation of God's Spirit

questions.question: Paul says when he came to the Corinthians, he did not come proclaiming the testimony of God with lofty speech or ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:1 (ESV): "And I, when I came to you, brothers, did not come proclaiming to you the testimony of God with lofty speech or wisdom."

questions.question: For I decided to know nothing among you except ____.
options: the grace of God and the fellowship of the Spirit
the cross of Christ and his resurrection
the love of the Father and the blood of the Lamb
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:2 (ESV): "For I decided to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified."

questions.question: Paul was with them in weakness and in fear and much trembling, and his message and preaching were not in plausible words of wisdom, but in demonstration of what?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:4 (ESV): "and my speech and my message were not in plausible words of wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,"

questions.question: Why did Paul preach in this manner? "so that your faith might not rest in the wisdom of men but in the ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:5 (ESV): "so that your faith might not rest in the wisdom of men but in the power of God."

questions.question: Yet among the mature Paul imparts a wisdom. It is not a wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are ____.
options: blinded by the god of this world
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:6 (ESV): "Yet among the mature we do impart wisdom, although it is not a wisdom of this age or of the rulers of this age, who are doomed to pass away."

questions.question: We impart a secret and hidden wisdom of God, which God decreed before the ages for our glory. If the rulers of this age had understood this, what would they not have done?
options: Mocked the King of the Jews
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:7-8 (ESV): "But we impart a secret and hidden wisdom of God, which God decreed before the ages for our glory. None of the rulers of this age understood this, for if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory."

questions.question: Paul quotes Isaiah: "What no eye has seen, nor ear heard, nor the heart of man imagined, what God has prepared for those who ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:9 (ESV): "But, as it is written, 'What no eye has seen, nor ear heard, nor the heart of man imagined, what God has prepared for those who love him'—"

questions.question: These things God has revealed to us through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches everything, even ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:10 (ESV): "these things God has revealed to us through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches everything, even the depths of God."

questions.question: For who knows a person's thoughts except the spirit of that person, which is in him? So also no one comprehends the thoughts of God except ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:11 (ESV): "For who knows a person's thoughts except the spirit of that person, which is in him? So also no one comprehends the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God."

questions.question: Now we have received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we might understand the things freely ____ us by God.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:12 (ESV): "Now we have received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit who is from God, that we might understand the things freely given to us by God."

questions.question: We impart this in words not taught by human wisdom but taught by the Spirit, interpreting ____ truths to those who are spiritual.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:13 (ESV): "And we impart this in words not taught by human wisdom but taught by the Spirit, interpreting spiritual truths to those who are spiritual."

questions.question: The natural person does not accept the things of the Spirit of God, for they are ____ to him.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:14 (ESV): "The natural person does not accept the things of the Spirit of God, for they are folly to him, and he is not able to understand them because they are spiritually discerned."

questions.question: Why is the natural person not able to understand the things of the Spirit of God?
options: Because they have rejected the truth
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:14 (ESV): "and he is not able to understand them because they are spiritually discerned."

questions.question: The spiritual person judges all things, but is himself to be judged by ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:15 (ESV): "The spiritual person judges all things, but is himself to be judged by no one."

questions.question: Paul concludes the chapter by stating: "For who has understood the mind of the Lord so as to instruct him? But we have the mind of ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 2:16 (ESV): "'For who has understood the mind of the Lord so as to instruct him?' But we have the mind of Christ."

key_verse_text: For I decided to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
